description: This source file is the application factory for a Flask-based web app. It sets up the Flask app instance, configures extensions such as SQLAlchemy and Flask-Login, registers blueprints for auth and views modules, initializes the database, and defines user loader and unauthorized handlers for login management.

classes.name: LoginManager
classes.description: Manages user login sessions, including user loading and handling unauthorized access.

classes.name: SQLAlchemy
classes.description: Provides ORM support for database interactions.

methods.name: create_app()
methods.description: Creates and configures the Flask application, sets up extensions, blueprints, database, and login management.

methods.name: load_user(id)
methods.description: User loader callback for Flask-Login, retrieves a User object based on user ID.

methods.name: unauthorized()
methods.description: Handler for unauthorized access, redirects to the signin page.
